name: Value Added Tax return
legal_reference: Value Added Tax Act, 2026, s. 54 — a registered person's tax period is one month (Category C: taxable supplies above P12 million, by authorisation, or by notice for regular default) or two months (Category A, ending January, March, May, July, September and November; Category B, ending February, April, June, August, October and December, allocated by the Commissioner General); s. 65(1) — a return is lodged for every period whether or not VAT is payable. Category A periods run December–January, February–March and so on; Ekwo's `bimonth` is anchored on January (January–February…) and so fits Category B only, which the README records as a gap. The approved return form (VAT 002.1) could not be opened, so only the components of the s. 55(1) formula are sourced; the value rows are this pack's own. No cadence is declared as the default because it depends on the taxpayer's category.

deadline.legal_reference: Value Added Tax Act, 2026, s. 65(1) — a registered person lodges the return within 28 days after the end of the tax period, and s. 66(1) — the VAT is payable by the same date. Twenty-eight days after the last day of any month falls on the 28th of the next month. Penalties and the interest of Schedule 5, para 6 (1 per cent a month) are not modelled.

boxes.name: Zero-rated supplies — exports
boxes.legal_reference: Value Added Tax Act, 2026, Schedule 1, Parts I and II — the value of exports of goods and services and international transport. A reporting row of this pack: the approved return form could not be opened, so its box numbers are not reproduced.

boxes.name: Zero-rated supplies — local
boxes.legal_reference: Value Added Tax Act, 2026, Schedule 1, Part III — the value of local supplies taxed at nil. A reporting row of this pack: the approved return form could not be opened, so its box numbers are not reproduced.

boxes.name: Exempt supplies
boxes.legal_reference: Value Added Tax Act, 2026, Schedule 2 — the value of exempt supplies. A reporting row of this pack: the approved return form could not be opened, so its box numbers are not reproduced.

boxes.name: Standard-rated supplies — value
boxes.legal_reference: Value Added Tax Act, 2026, s. 7(2)(b) — the sales on which output tax is charged at 14 %. A reporting row of this pack: the approved return form could not be opened, so its box numbers are not reproduced.

boxes.name: Output tax on standard-rated supplies
boxes.legal_reference: Value Added Tax Act, 2026, s. 55(1), component A — the output tax receivable on taxable supplies made in the period, net of credit notes issued.

boxes.name: Reverse charged supplies — value
boxes.legal_reference: Value Added Tax Act, 2026, s. 7(1)(c) — the value of remote services received on which the registered recipient accounts for the VAT. A reporting row of this pack: the approved return form could not be opened, so its box numbers are not reproduced.

boxes.name: Reverse charged VAT
boxes.legal_reference: Value Added Tax Act, 2026, s. 55(1), component B — the reverse charged VAT the registered person is liable for in the period.

boxes.name: Output VAT (A + B)
boxes.legal_reference: Value Added Tax Act, 2026, s. 55(1) — components A and B of the net VAT formula: output tax on supplies plus reverse charged VAT.

boxes.name: Zero-rated purchases — value
boxes.legal_reference: Value Added Tax Act, 2026, Schedule 1 — the value of local purchases taxed at nil. A reporting row of this pack: the approved return form could not be opened, so its box numbers are not reproduced.

boxes.name: Standard-rated local purchases — value
boxes.legal_reference: Value Added Tax Act, 2026, s. 31 — the purchases on which input tax is claimed. A reporting row of this pack: the approved return form could not be opened, so its box numbers are not reproduced.

boxes.name: Input tax on local purchases
boxes.legal_reference: Value Added Tax Act, 2026, s. 55(1), component C — input tax credits allowed on local acquisitions, net of credits received.

boxes.name: Imports of goods — value
boxes.legal_reference: Value Added Tax Act, 2026, s. 7(1)(b) — the value of taxable imports on which VAT was paid at the border. A reporting row of this pack: the approved return form could not be opened, so its box numbers are not reproduced.

boxes.name: Input tax on imports
boxes.legal_reference: Value Added Tax Act, 2026, s. 55(1) and (3) — input tax credit on taxable imports, claimed in the period of the import or the next.

boxes.name: Input tax on reverse charged supplies
boxes.legal_reference: Value Added Tax Act, 2026, s. 55(1), component C — the input tax credit allowed on reverse charged supplies used in the taxable activity.

boxes.name: Input tax credits (C)
boxes.legal_reference: Value Added Tax Act, 2026, s. 55(1), component C — the total input tax credit allowed for the period.

boxes.name: Net VAT payable or refundable
boxes.legal_reference: Value Added Tax Act, 2026, s. 55(1) — (A + B) − C. A positive figure is payable by the due date of the return (s. 66(1)); an excess credit is carried forward (s. 56) or refunded within 28 days of the return (s. 57).
